title: Are There Lost Alien Civilizations in Our Past?
summary: Kurzgesagt asks whether advanced civilizations could have existed on Earth in the deep past and left little evidence. It looks at time as a dimension for searching for alien civilizations and the limits of the geological record.
why: HN brings it up in threads on ancient civilizations and detecting past technology in geology.
